WEEK 2 – MONDAY TRAINING
COACH CHEAT SHEET (VERSION 1)
THEME: Distance Control & Jab System
PHASE: Accumulation
DURATION: 2 Hours (1 Hr Non‑Contact + 1 Hr Contact)
--- NON‑CONTACT (4:00–5:00 PM) ---
• Instruction & setup
• Mirror footwork – 3 rounds
• Distance line drill – 4 rounds
• Jab entry system – 3 rounds
• Defensive reactions – slip, parry, step back
• Bag rounds – jab, combos, pivot exit
• Reflection walk & exit
--- CONTACT (5:00–6:00 PM) ---
• Technical partner entries
• Situational sparring – jab only, double jab, defensive counters
• Technical sparring – controlled rounds
• Fight pace bag work – volume → combos → speed
• Cooldown & exit

INSTRUCTOR SCRIPT (VERSION 3)
4:00 – "Circle up. Today we’re working distance control and the jab system."
4:05 – "Partners face each other. Leader moves first — react clean."
4:15 – "On the line. Step in, step out — control space."
4:25 – "Single jabs only. Clean mechanics."
4:35 – "Defense only. Small slips, tight parries."
4:45 – "On the bags — jab volume."
4:55 – "Walk, breathe, reflect."
5:00 – "Contact session starts. Partner up."
5:05 – "Jab–cross entry, slip cross — slow and clean."
5:15 – "Round 1: jab only scoring."
5:30 – "Controlled sparring — light, clean touches only."
5:40 – "Fight pace bags — push volume."
5:50 – "Cooldown and reset."
